info.name: Microsoft Azure AccessControlClient AccessConnector Timezone API
Microsoft Azure Get Timezone Byid Format

params.name: subscription-key
params.description: One of the Azure Maps keys provided from an Azure Map Account. Please refer to this [article](https://docs.microsoft.com/azure/azure-maps/how-to-manage-authentication) for details on how to manage authentication.

params.name: api-version
params.description: Version number of Azure Maps API. Current version is 1.0

params.name: options
params.description: Alternatively, use alias "o". Options available for types of information returned in the result.

params.name: timeStamp
params.description: Alternatively, use alias "stamp", or "s". Reference time, if omitted, the API will use the machine time serving the request.

params.name: transitionsFrom
params.description: Alternatively, use alias "tf". The start date from which daylight savings time (DST) transitions are requested, only applies when "options" = all or "options" = transitions.

params.name: transitionsYears
params.description: Alternatively, use alias "ty". The number of years from "transitionsFrom" for which DST transitions are requested, only applies when "options" = all or "options" = transitions.

params.name: format
params.description: Desired format of the response. Only `json` format is supported.

params.name: query
params.description: The IANA time zone ID.

items.docs:
__Time Zone by Id__

**Applies to**: S0 and S1 pricing tiers.


This API returns current, historical, and future time zone information for the specified IANA time zone ID.

items.docs:
__Time Zone by Coordinates__

**Applies to**: S0 and S1 pricing tiers.


This API returns current, historical, and future time zone information for a specified latitude-longitude pair. In addition, the API provides sunset and sunrise times for a given location.

items.docs:
__Windows to IANA Time Zone__


**Applies to**: S0 and S1 pricing tiers.


This API returns a corresponding IANA ID, given a valid Windows Time Zone ID. Multiple IANA IDs may be returned for a single Windows ID. It is possible to narrow these results by adding an optional territory parameter.
